text: The authors build on error consistency, which measures overlap in the samples where two models err beyond what is expected by chance from their accuracies, and extend it by counting differences in predictions rather than correctness on each sample and by incorporating output probabilities; the resulting metric, Chance Adjusted Probabilistic Alignment (CAPA, kappa_p), quantifies functional similarity between models.
title: CAPA: chance-adjusted probabilistic agreement as a model similarity metric
